title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: Hold: Microsoft now documents a 0.13-credit charge for calling an agent node, plus usage-based charges, so the statement that no agent-node rate is published needs narrowing. Exhausting an environment's prepaid allocation does not necessarily block new runs: tenant-pool capacity or linked pay-as-you-go billing can keep usage running. The listed control paths and API operations are supported.
